shortDescription: The CrowdStrike outage that led to estimated insured losses of $400 million to $1.5 billion occurred in 2024. "Microsoft Outage Unlikely to Cost Insurers as Much as CrowdStrike's Did — WSJ," at 11:11 a.m. ET, incorrectly said it happened in 2025.
